criteria.note: 13-bit packed struct from 8 payload, 4 tag and 1 poison bit.
39 bits from three packed 13-bit lane_t elements under the explicit StrbWidth/byte_t overrides.
65 packed bits from Depth=5 and 13-bit data_t.
Both q pointers are 4 bits from $clog2(5)+1.
Exactly three generated lane FIFOs contribute 3*(65+4+4)=219 requested q bits.
Explicit 39-bit beat_t and FifoDepth=5 give 195 bits; the remaining numeric DataWidth=32 does not determine the overridden type width.
Both signals have 3 bits from cnt_width(5)=idx_width(6)=$clog2(6).
Correct no answer supported by macro clear arguments: flush clears pointers/count, memory clear uses clr_i; clock edge, asynchronous active-low reset and ordinary write possibility are addressed.

summary: Complete and source-supported width, state-total and packet flush/clear analysis.
